scope: US/KR equities and crypto tick feasibility for Jev (TypeSafe System One) assisted paper research

limitations: Local evidence is daily OHLCV only.
The inventory is cited from the dated repo report, not re-enumerated during this task.
Do not synthesize minute/second paths from daily bars.

inspection_method: find file names only for inventory
3-line samples from one KR and one crypto_spot JSONL
can_test: price-only event/change/return proxies with explicit receive-time caveat
cannot_test: signed volume delta or aggressor/maker flow
queue position, spread-crossing execution, or calibrated market impact
caveats: Counts are filename inventory, not row counts or coverage proof.
Only three sample lines per category were read.
An initially broad *kr.jsonl pattern overcounted crypto_perp; exact basename kr.jsonl was recounted and returned 36.

Coin_Trade/app/tick_stream.py.interpretation: Subscription code does not establish successful coverage, no-delay status, or historical availability. The KIS catalog labels overseas trade feed as delayed real-time execution price.

jev.request_response_style: HTTPS request returning typed answers and token usage
jev.decision: Cannot infer second-level feasibility from Jev latency alone; measure p50/p90/p95/p99/end-to-end under representative shadow traffic and enforce local deadline/fail-closed behavior.

market_rules.us_dst_note: KST local conversion changes with EST/EDT; use exchange timezone and calendar
market_rules.us_short_sale: Regulation SHO marking and locate requirements; Rule 201 10% circuit breaker restricts short-sale price for remainder of day and following trading day
market_rules.kr_short_sale: Covered short only under borrowing/verification constraints; KRX uptick rule applies
market_rules.us_tick_rule: Do not hardcode one cent for all NMS stocks; SEC Rule 612 symbol assignments and 2026 compliance relief require current verification
market_rules.kr_tick_rule: KRX price-band tick schedule; instrument-specific exceptions require validation
market_rules.fees: Account- and date-specific rates were not verified; historical repo research assumptions are not current fee guarantees

research_boundary.true_second_or_tick_historical_us_equity: not feasible with current local archive/cache
research_boundary.crypto_price_only_proxy_test: feasible with caveats; not exact exchange-event replay
research_boundary.equity_minute_proxy: possible only after broker/API data access and endpoint retention/coverage validation; not a substitute for tick/orderbook history
local_engine_tests: risk gate and paper order lifecycle
external_prerequisites: KIS paper account and API authorization
verify current KIS WebSocket support, US delay, symbol caps, and historical minute limits
licensed historical trades plus quotes/depth and source timestamps for actual orderflow replay
TypeSafe account/API access, current quota/cost terms, representative shadow latency measurement
account-specific commissions, taxes, FX, borrow and slippage schedule
